svg.title: Integrated multiplier
svg.text: DCCREG turbine: the multiplier stacked into the doubler, run bipolar, feeding the rings — as laid out, PROPOSED (2026-10-11)
The designer's ladder C3–C6 / D5–D8 as sketched; chain 2 reversed (D2, D4, D5, D8): side A negative, side B positive; C1 / C2 in phase; one stage past each varicap node to its ring. Ideal diodes.

blue: the chain that charges ring B (side B, positive) · red: the chain that charges ring A (side A, negative) · rev.: reversed against the sketch · new: added for the rings · amber: the surge resistors (PROPOSED)
side B, in phase with C1
REF: the counter-rotor's stator vanes; one inner bearing to the shaft (the study: 0.02 µA rms; the record's 165 µA)
7.52 kV/cm at the null, B to A (7.50 with the can)
ripple 0.006 kV/cm p-p · the null at 0 V by symmetry
the study: 7.60 kV/cm (±14.93 kV); the record as built 7.06
the designer's ladder (C3–C6 180 pF, D5–D8), bipolar: chain 2 reversed; C1 / C2 in phase (in antiphase it does not pump); each chain one stage past its varicap node to its ring
the layout's strays, 1–3 pF on each new node; the clamps trimmed to 60 parts, V_op 11.94 kV: the rings −14.77 / +14.77 kV, 7.52 kV/cm at the null; each chain 25.0 µA
2026-10-10: 24.5 pF assumed on each new node [RH] and the record's clamps (13.1 kV): the rings ±14.93 kV, 7.60 kV/cm. The layout's strays with those clamps give ±16.25 kV: hence the trim
12 HV sticks, one a position, reverse ≤ 6.1 kV (the record: 14, its D3 / D4 13.2 kV on two each)
Ca / Cb now hold 12.0 kV (the record's 6.9); C5 / C6 11.7, C3 / C4 8.2, C7 / C8 6.1, Csa / Csb 14.8 kV
z 1.0164 free as laid out (1.0159 with the capacitors' mounts; the study 1.0142); the clamps 594 mW; 95 % in 1.22 s from a 1 kV seed; the counter-rotor can float (Q1 = −Q2)
PROPOSED, the drawing set: the sticks XCH 2CL77 (P-002); C3–C6 190 pF / 30 kV, the nearest catalogue value (P-003); C7 / C8 and Csa / Csb 100 pF / 40 kV (P-004);
R1–R4 22 kΩ in series with D1–D4 (P-005); Z1 / Z4 strings of 66 × 1.5KE200A, trimmed to 60 on the bench (P-006)
the study's: seeds 51 V / 947 V / 4870 V (typical / maximum / hot; the record 122 V / 1.0 kV / 3.65 kV); the rings ±14.67 / ±14.40 / ±13.95 kV, 7.47 / 7.33 / 7.10 kV/cm
a field solve of the new stack would fix the trim, the bench sets it; the mounts move the rings −9 V

Numbers: sim/multiplier_waveforms_results.json (as laid out), sim/multiplier_layout_results.json (the strays, the trim), sim/doubler_caps_results.json (the mounts), sim/integrated_multiplier_results.json (the study, real sticks) ·
